description: The remote MCP servers the signed-in account watches, with their security level, the slots and the offers. We check every watched server once a day and e-mail the account when something changes: tools added, removed or rewritten, the server state, the security level, the country of the server or the version. The e-mail goes to the verified address of the account and carries an unsubscribe link.
name: list_watched_tools
title: List watched tools
